every_position_composed.reason: Both sites use identical camera choreography across frames 1 to 9, including the same text-overlapping issue in frame 5 and cut-off cabinet in frame 8.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D factory metaphor—showing raw logs pressed in frame 5, stored in the anchor rack in frame 6, and routed to hosts in frame 8.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Across frames 1 to 9, the second site renders a matte slate floor with visible grid lines, crisp cast shadows, and atmospheric horizon depth, grounding the dark machinery far better than the pitch-black floor of the first site.

type_and_layout.reason: While the typography and card layouts in frames 1, 3, 5, 6, 8, and 9 are identical, the lighter slate ground plane in the second site creates much clearer visual separation around the dark UI cards.

overall.reason: While both sites share the exact same layout, copy, models, and scroll choreography, the second site's lit slate ground plane makes cast shadows, spatial perspective, and dark machinery contours read clearly instead of getting lost in a black void.
